messages.content:
Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

a man bought 20 shares of rs . 50 at 5 discount , the rate of dividend being 13 . the rate of interest obtained is :

A. 27 %
B. 87 %
C. 15 %
D. 66 %
E. 88 %

message.content:
Investment = 20 × (50 − 5) = Rs. 900. Dividend = 13% of (20 × 50) = Rs. 130. Rate = 130/900 ≈ 14.4%, closest to 15%.

ANSWER: C
message.reasoning_content: Investment: 20×45=900, dividend 20×6.5=130 →13%. Options don't have 13%... closest C 15%. Likely intended answer 15%.

final_content:

ANSWER: C
